rules.title: Dual-function breakers
rules.text: Every 120V breaker is a dual-function AFCI/GFCI breaker. The crew never picks a GFCI outlet for protection — protection lives at the breaker.

rules.title: Garage outlet height
rules.text: Garage outlets at 48 in to center.

rules.title: Outdoor outlet height
rules.text: Outdoor outlets at 24 in above grade.

rules.title: Wall receptacle height
rules.text: Wall receptacles at 18 in to the BOTTOM of the box. If the plan detail shows a different height, the plan governs.

rules.title: Microwave circuit
rules.text: The microwave gets its own dedicated 20A circuit. Wire material/size: PENDING Mike Holt ruling (12 AWG copper vs Sharma CCA standard) — do not use this entry for material until the ruling lands.
